Crispy noodles topped with a delicious sweet, sour, and spicy honey chilli gravy loaded with veggies, paneer, and juicy pineapple. A really interesting combination of flavours and textures that makes this dish so special!
I’ve shown you how to make perfectly crispy noodles at home, and the gravy comes together in no time. If you love Indo-Chinese food, you definitely need to try this one. The full written recipe is mentioned below in the description. Happy Cooking!
